answer: A resilient defense is mutual-bonded identity syndicates. Each new agent must join a pool whose members co-sign one another's uniqueness and post shared collateral. An attacker spawning a sybil ring in a quiet lagoon quickly finds every clone entangled in the same thread of mutual liability; one exposed fake slashes the whole orchard of co-signed accounts. The cost of recruiting unrelated honest co-signers scales with the ring size, so mass impersonation becomes economically fatal.
